initial:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: brand identity concept sheet for Luma Home, an open-source native television home dashboard.
Primary request: create one coherent original icon and wordmark, ready to recreate in SVG. The product has a calm, Apple TV-like interface but do NOT borrow Apple, Plex or PlxNative logos or brand artwork.
Subject: a refined geometric L monogram that also suggests a softly illuminated home/TV frame. Design one simple continuous rounded line: a compact rounded rectangular frame with an open upper-right corner, where the lower-left inner line reads as an L. One small mint light accent at the upper-right opening. It must remain recognizable as a monochrome 32px icon.
Style: flat vector-like graphic design, clear deliberate geometry, minimal shapes, no 3D, no mockup devices, no textures, no photographic effects. Subtle solid colour contrast rather than complex gradients.
Composition: a wide clean brand sheet on graphite. Main large square app icon on the left, a matching icon plus wordmark lockup on the right. Along the bottom show the identical mark in monochrome light and dark versions and three restrained palette swatches. Lots of negative space.
Palette: graphite #24262B, soft off-white #F5F6F7, cool mint #A5F0D4. Make the icon a graphite rounded square containing the off-white mark with the small mint accent. Keep the monochrome versions faithful.
Text verbatim: "Luma Home" in a restrained modern humanist sans serif, with a small secondary line "Native TV dashboard". Palette labels may be "Graphite", "Soft white", "Mint".
Constraints: exactly one identity repeated consistently across the sheet. Balanced rounded corners, medium-thick strokes, no house roof cliché, no play triangle, no gradients needed. Legible strong silhouette. No watermarks. This is original project branding; no third-party brand marks.
oled_revision: Edit this Luma Home brand concept sheet. Preserve the exact identity, geometric open frame/L monogram, mint accent, wordmark text and general composition. Adapt the branding to an OLED-first product: replace the broad graphite page background and the dark app icon tile background with perfectly flat pure black #000000. Remove all textures, gradients, glows, vignettes and lighting; use crisp solid colours only. Keep the off-white and mint mark bright but spatially small. In the lower palette, replace "Graphite" and "#24262B" with "OLED black" and "#000000". Keep "Soft white" "#F5F6F7" and "Mint" "#A5F0D4". For the lower monochrome variants use an entirely off-white mark including dot on black, and an entirely black mark including dot on off-white; these must really be monochrome. Preserve text verbatim "Luma Home" and "Native TV dashboard". No extra logos or slogans. This is a flat, clean, vector-friendly design sheet.
vector_recreation: Manual SVG geometry and OFL Inter glyph outlines using assets/luma-home/generate.py; flat black canvas, separate graphite UI palette role.
